notes.title: Important Update 8.3
notes.notes:
Dear Players:
     Thanks for enjoying our game.We also want to satisfy everyone as much as we can, so we are developing something new, I hope everyone will like it. We have released a new version update, updated as follows:

     [h1]BOSS challenge[/h1]
     As part of the player's needs, we have added challenge mode,a total of three modules, and now open the BOSS challenge, the rules are as follows:

     1, You must pass through normal or difficult mode before you can enter the challenge of BOSS in the challenge mode.   
     2, The challenge of BOSS in a total of 4 story mode BOSS, but were slightly enhanced (Ryuzaki of the first day is back).
     3, We will record the maximum performance (challenge time and remaining HP volume) of each BOSS.

     [h1]New features and adjustments[/h1]

     1, Some players monitor refresh rate is very high, there have been pictures of tearing and jitter, etc., we have fixed a BUG of V-Sync. The current high refresh rate (for example higher than 60HZ) monitor you can prevent the picture from tearing by adjusting the V-Sync option.    
     2, We've added new support for the 2K screen and the 4K screen, but the player's monitor should supports 2K and 4K.
     3, Added the cross key selection menu, now you use the joystick or cross key, you can choose the menu.
     4, Weaken the final BOSS, giving the player more fault tolerant space.     
     5. Fixed some small BUG.

     [h1]New feature trailer[/h1]
     
     Special mode: 
     We made a special level, you can control Ryuzaki or Kyuya in this level, Ryuzaki and Kyuya have the same skills as they are in story mode.
     
     Memory mode: 
     We show players in the official group some of the items that have been abandoned at the beginning of the design and developing. Many players are interested in them. So we decided to create a memory mode in which players would into a relatively complete Acade that we originally made and then abandoned. You will control the earlist version of Ruri, and explore in the scene. We will leave much text in many places, which recorded here once designed what story, or here happened what problems and interesting problems when developing.

     Thanks. If you like our game, help us to promote it please.THANKS!

notes.title: Update Notice 7.25
notes.notes:
Dear Players:
     We updated a new version.We hope you will enjoy it.
     
     1.Now when shooting,the camera will not be reset and shake.
     2.Now shooting is quicker.
     3.Now shooting will let enemies who is hited do hurt action for more time.
     4.If you are pressing Block Button, you will be blocking when you can do any action.
     5.When you are doing hurt action, you can use unique skill to survive.
     6.If you inputed anything when action is coming to end,you will do new action immediately, you will not feel "stiff" now.

     Thank you very much. If you like the game, please help us promote it. Thanks, we will keep improving the game.

notes.title: Update Notice 7.22
notes.notes:
Dear Players:
    Thanks for trusting us.We updated a new version.Here is the release note:
    
    1.Now ,you can diy custom input of gamepad now.
    2.When you are diy custom input, you can use keys of keypad now.
    3.You can reset all the input to default now.
    4.When fighting against with BOSS, you can choose locking camera or unlocking camera, it's in camera settings.
    5.We reduce the cost of energy of quick-charging(you should buy the skill first).
    6.We reduce the reserve time of charging action.
    7.When you use unique skill finish an area, you will increase HP of that action before statistics.
    8.We increase the inputable time of some actions.Now you can combo easier.
    9.We improved some performance of this game.
    10.Fixed: when the game is pausing, the sound effect will not loop now.

    About plan of the game for furture:
    1.We will develop a challenge mode,you can challenge the strongest Ryuzaki and other BOSS directly.
    2.We are considering whether to develop Kyuya as a control-able player.
    3.Cost of a new scene is very high, but in the beginning of the project we have done a complete school (you can see the pictures on some walls of first level and second level).We will consider bringing that school back into the game for you .
    4.All update in the furture is for free.Enjoy the game.
   
    Sorry for my poor English. Thank you.We hope you can enjoy the game. If you like the game, could you give us a positive review?

notes.title: Important Update(7.20)
notes.notes:
Dear Players:
     We had read about three hundreds reviews yestoday and communicated with many players.We do this update and we hope you can enjoy our game.
     1.You can press Q and E to rotate the camera.
     2.You can change the speed of QE-Camera rotating.(in settings --- camera settings)
     3.You can reverse the forward direction of QE-Camera rotating.
     4.You can disable the auto-rotate of camera when you are moving.
     5.You can reverse the forward direction of camera's auto-rotate.
     6.You can press the ResetCamera Button(RS on gamepad and defult P on keyboard),then you can reset the camera view.
     7.When reset the camera view, we disabled the radial blur effect.
     8.When you are attacking, you will attack the enemies which are front of you first,so that you won't auto change target now.
     9.When you are evading, you will not be attacked in the first half action.
     10.You can use base action(evade,jump,sprint etc.)to interrupt your current action.
     11.After you are underattack for 1 second,you can use base action to interrupt your current hurt action.But if you are attacked 

again,you will still be underattack.
     12.If your block is broken, you can use base action to interrupt current action.
     13.We reduced Ryuzaki's ability. Now he is not so hard for someone.
     14.Fixed: Unique skill can't kill VE-Type Robot,now it's fixed.
     15.Fixed: Now all skills data will be send to cloud,you can use your data everywhere.
     16.Fixed: Somewhere of scene will cause issues.We fixed some of those.
     17.When you are choosing hard mode, you will see a text to make sure.

     We are improving our game and we will keep improving it. We really hope you can enjoy our game.If you like our game, please give a positive evaluation in our store page. Thanks very much.

notes.title: Important Update !!!
notes.notes:
Dear players:
     We updated a new version. We will keep improving the game.Please support us.Here is the release note:

     1.We support DIY the keyboard input by yourself now. You can diy your input in control settings panel.
     2.We increased the distance between player and the camera so that you can have larger view and the enemies can't assault you easily.
     3.We change the camera view when you are sprinting so that you can know more about the enemies around.
     4.We changed the lock-on system for BOSS. We rewrote the logic.Now you can keep locking on the boss.
     5.We increased the area of execute.When you are not attacking and get closed to the week enemies, you can execute it easily.
     6.When you are blocking, you still can attack. So you can switch attack and defense directly.
     7.We changed the sound effects'settings, now you can hear the sound of shooting everywhere.
     8.We developed the speed setting of camera rotate when you are moving.You can use it in control setting panel.
     9.We developed the speed setting of camera rotate for mannual rotate.You can use it in control setting panel.
     10.Now you can reverse the forward direction for mannual rotate.
     11.When player is knocked down or knocked fly,player will be protected so that you can do action.
     12.When you are attacking after perfect evade, you will not miss.
     13.You can use the RT skill for BOSS now.It will recover your health and do much damage for BOSS.
     14.We reduced the area of Ryuzaki's skills.
     15.We added some notice for playing better.
     16.When your energy is full, the UI will enable a visual effect.
     17.In entertainment mode and normal mode, you will be stronger and you can recover energy by every attack.
     18.Now you will lock the shooter prioritized.
     19.We increased the area of player's attacking, now you will not attack miss.

     We are appreciative you can choose this game. We are developing more to make the game better. We hope you can support us and give us a positive review. Thanks very much.We love you.
